question.prompt: A student scored 85 points on the midterm. The semester grade is calculated with the midterm accounting for 40% and the final exam accounting for 60%. What is the minimum integer score on the final exam needed for a semester grade of at least 90 points?

solutions.explanation: \(85\times0.4=34\), so \(0.6x\ge56\) is required, giving \(x\ge93.3\ldots\). Taking an integer gives 94 (a score of 93 gives an overall grade of 89.8, which is insufficient).
solutions.title: Solve the weighted-score inequality
